name: Ricotta Gnocchi (Worlds of Marvel)
whyItWorks: Ricotta and white-flour gnocchi pillows are even lighter and softer than potato gnocchi, requiring almost zero chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the gnocchi with light sauce or plain butter and parmesan, and push aside any whole wild mushrooms or spinach leaves.
watchOuts: Ricotta lactose — take a Lactaid pill
